section.h1: Study the Scriptures, one verse at a time
p: A quiet, unhurried walk through the Bible — a passage, then a verse at a time, with a short note on each. Nothing to buy, no account, no tracking.
Choose a book from the menu to begin. Every study is free to read and free to share.

li: Read the whole passage first, slowly.
Then take it verse by verse, with the short note beside each.
Sit with one idea before moving on. There is no rush here.
